description.from:
**Phase 5 of MVP** under `PPY-54055d`.

## Intent

As a publication operator, I want a diff, provenance, and a human approval gate, so externally attributable copy is never auto-published and quality outcomes can be tracked over time.

## Done when

- Operator sees a **diff** (original vs proposed), not an auto-published rewrite.
- Provenance retained: original draft, each revision, model/version, retrieved sources, change log, human approve/reject.
- External publish requires human approval.
- Quality metrics logged over time: accepted revisions, deletions, unsupported-claim rate, reader edits, post-publication corrections.

## Depends on

Verifier + acceptance gate.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Diff handoff, provenance, and human approval
  As a publication operator
  I want a reviewable diff and a provenance log
  So I can approve or reject a revision and never auto-publish external copy

  Scenario: Present a diff instead of publishing
    Given a proposed revision that passed or failed the acceptance gate
    When the operator opens the handoff
    Then they see a diff of original versus proposed copy
    And the revision is not published to an external surface

  Scenario: Record provenance and the human decision
    Given a proposed revision with model version, retrieved sources, and change log
    When a human approves or rejects it
    Then provenance retains the original draft, each revision, model version, retrieved sources, change log, and the human decision
    And quality metrics can record accepted revisions, deletions, and unsupported-claim rate
```
description.to:
**Phase 5 of MVP** under `PPY-54055d`.

## Intent

As a publication operator, I want to record finding-level steering, choose among rewrite options, apply patches myself, and see a diff — so the loop stays interactive and externally attributable copy is never auto-published.

## Done when

- Operator can record per-finding decisions: skip, rewrite, delete, keep, add.
- Operator sees options for rewrite findings and records choose / edit / reject / regenerate-with-guidance.
- Operator sees a **diff** (original vs working draft) after apply, not an auto-published rewrite.
- Working draft changes only when a human apply is recorded.
- Provenance retained: original draft, findings, finding decisions, options, chosen option ids, model/version, retrieved sources, change log, human apply/approve/reject.
- External publish requires human approval.
- Quality metrics logged over time: accepted revisions, deletions, unsupported-claim rate, reader edits, post-publication corrections.

## Depends on

Verifier + acceptance gate.

## Gherkin

```gherkin
Feature: Steer, choose, apply, and provenance
  As a publication operator
  I want to steer findings and choose rewrite options
  So a human remains the editor and machines only propose

  Scenario: Steer findings before any rewrite
    Given diagnostic findings for a draft
    When the operator marks some findings skip and others rewrite
    Then option generation is eligible only for rewrite findings
    And the working draft is unchanged

  Scenario: Choose an option and apply a patch
    Given two or three options for a finding marked rewrite
    When the operator chooses one option and records apply
    Then the working draft includes that patch
    And provenance records the finding id, option id, model version, and human decision

  Scenario: Present a diff and do not publish
    Given a working draft after one or more applies
    When the operator opens the handoff
    Then they see a diff of original versus working draft
    And the revision is not published to an external surface
```
